  • Method Details

    • findAll

      public List<Item> findAll() throws SQLException
      Reads every row in items where is_visible is true. Allergy info is not selected, so each item's allergy info is empty.
      Returns:
      the visible items, ordered by id descending (newest first)
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the query fails

    • save

      public Item save(String name, double price, boolean seasonal) throws SQLException
      Inserts a new item, in stock. If seasonal is true, the item is also linked to the "Seasonal Menu" category in the same transaction.
      Parameters:
      name - item name
      price - item price
      seasonal - whether to add the item to the Seasonal Menu category
      Returns:
      the inserted item with its generated id; allergy info is empty
      Throws:
      SQLException - if either insert fails; nothing is saved in that case

    • update

      public Item update(Item item) throws SQLException
      Updates the name, price and in_stock columns of the row matching the item's id. The allergy_info column is not written.
      Parameters:
      item - the item to save; its id selects the row
      Returns:
      the updated row; allergy info is copied from item, not read from the database
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the update fails or no row has that id

    • deleteById

      public void deleteById(long id) throws SQLException
      Soft-deletes an item by setting is_visible to false. The row itself is kept in the database.
      Parameters:
      id - item id
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the update fails or no row has that id

    • findByCategory

      public List<Item> findByCategory(String categoryName) throws SQLException
      Reads the items linked to a category through item_categories, including allergy info.
      Parameters:
      categoryName - category name, matched exactly
      Returns:
      the category's items, ordered by name
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the query fails
